children: AXA should achieve the upper end of its earnings per share target range, Berenberg's Michael Huttner writes. The French insurer's new higher underlying EPS growth target is credible, Berenberg says. It is driven by increased, but conservative, top-line growth targets, the analyst says. AXA targets 6% to 7% revenue growth from 2027 through 2029, despite being on track to achieve a 6% growth rate from 2024 through 2026 while reorganizing the business. Berenberg estimates AXA's underlying EPS annual growth will rise to an "attractive level" of 9.1% from 2027 through 2029, compared to the new 7% to 9% target range. Berenberg maintains a buy recommendation and 77 euro price target. Shares are down 0.4% at 43.72 euros. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
